entries.name: Pauline Kathleen Sims

expected.charges: Breach of the peace — Freedom Ride arrival at the Jackson Trailways terminal, August 14, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected.sentence: Arrested 1961-08-14. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: Raymond Arsenault records thirty days actually spent in a Jackson jail following the August 1961 Freedom Ride. Exact release date remains unverified. The existing August 14 arrest date is retained; the roster groups the ride under August 13, so incarceration is recorded at month precision pending reconciliation.
